proposals.evidence: Section 8 *latra, compared with litra, explicitly gives Bashkarik lāλ and Torwali lāš “bad”. These survey lateral-fricative/sibilant forms match the named local comparanda, preserving the source spelling lalɬ as a variant rather than normalizing it. This is a qualified member of Turner’s expressive defective family; it does not assert a regular derivation from the unrelated cloth sense in section 1.
